name: SendEmail
description: Sends an email from a specified mailbox using Microsoft Graph, with support for recipients, content, priority, and sensitivity.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Select Microsoft 365 credentials used to authenticate the request.

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: The email address of the mailbox to send the email from.

fields.name: To
fields.label: To
fields.description: Primary recipient email address(es). Separate multiple addresses with semicolons (;).

fields.name: CC
fields.label: CC
fields.description: Carbon copy recipient email address(es). Separate multiple addresses with semicolons (;).

fields.name: BCC
fields.label: BCC
fields.description: Blind carbon copy recipient email address(es). Separate multiple addresses with semicolons (;).

fields.name: Subject
fields.label: Subject
fields.description: Subject line of the email message.

fields.name: ContentType
fields.label: Content Type
fields.description: Format of the email body content.

fields.name: Content
fields.label: Body
fields.description: The main content of the email message. The format of the content should match the selected Content Type (e.g., plain text or HTML).

fields.name: Importance
fields.label: Importance
fields.description: Specifies the priority of the email message. 'Low' indicates low priority, 'Normal' indicates normal priority, and 'High' indicates high priority. Setting the appropriate importance level can help recipients understand the urgency of the email.

fields.name: Sensitivity
fields.label: Sensitivity
fields.description: Indicates the sensitivity level of the email message. 'Normal' indicates normal sensitivity, 'Personal' indicates personal sensitivity, 'Private' indicates private sensitivity, and 'Confidential' indicates confidential sensitivity. Setting the appropriate sensitivity level can help recipients understand how to handle the email message.

fields.name: SaveToSentItems
fields.label: Save to Sent Items
fields.description: Indicates whether to save a copy of the sent email in the Sent Items folder. Set to 'true' to save the email in Sent Items, or 'false' to not save it.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Indicates whether the email was sent successfully.
